crossRefs.note: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden…
Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his…
Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun…
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes…
from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your…
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
“He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;
for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds…

translations.web: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
translations.bsb: I hated all for which I had toiled under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
translations.kjv: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after
translations.asv: And I hated all my labor wherein I labored under the sun, seeing that I must leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
